title: Inner product of a finite linear combination
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $I$ be finite sets, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb C$, $a:I\to\mathbb C$, and $g:I\to(\Omega\to\mathbb C)$. Then $\left\langle f,\sum_{i\in I}a(i)g_i\right\rangle_p=\sum_{i\in I}a(i)\langle f,g_i\rangle_p$, where the sum of functions is taken pointwise and $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_p$ is the probability-weighted complex inner product.
